title: The Courtyard Lanterns (Los farolillos del patio)

scenes.title: Junto a la verja de hierro
scenes.summary: Hannah brings tea to the courtyard table as Caleb uses her three simple sentences to break the ice with Owen.

scenes.title: El tren de madera
scenes.summary: Caleb hands Owen their grandfather's carved wooden train just as childhood piano teacher Evelyn steps over to greet them.

scenes.title: Treinta días en papel
scenes.summary: Behind the front desk Arthur laments the sale notice while Graham and Hannah urge him not to give up without reading the fine print.

scenes.title: Pastel de limón y vista aguda
scenes.summary: Enjoying Tessa's warm lemon cake, Owen notices the worried faces inside the lobby window and offers help.

scenes.title: Página dos, cláusula catorce
scenes.summary: Examining page two of the letter, Caleb points out Heritage Clause 14 protecting historic buildings with public ground-floor cafes.

scenes.title: Llaves permanentes
scenes.summary: Beaming with relief, Arthur greenlights Tessa's morning courtyard cafe and offers Hannah the permanent front-desk job.

scenes.title: Bajo los farolillos dorados
scenes.summary: As evening lanterns glow across the courtyard, Hannah, Evelyn, and Owen toast the week's unexpected friendships.

scenes.title: La habitación nueve
scenes.summary: Fetching spare cafe chairs from the cellar, Graham uncovers a locked wooden crate stamped 'Room 9' and a ninth brass key.
